comparison_to_20c.statement: All four logged Basin levels and UserDemand cumulative deliveries are identical to the qualified DUMMY-20C no-groundwater-exchange product route at reported precision.
comparison_to_20c.implication: The intended treatment was absent; the frozen groundwater-response reference was never actually exercised.

interpretation: The one-cell MF6 representation combining the fixed-head time leader and DRN boundary did not produce a nonzero DRN flux after the intended 6 h activation.
RibaMod correctly propagated the observed zero MF6 drain flux as zero Ribasim basin.drainage.
Therefore the 12 h and later reference mismatches do not falsify the post-allocation groundwater-memory hypothesis; they show that the intervention fixture failed to realize its treatment.
A new work unit must first demonstrate the physical 0 -> 8 m3/day MF6-to-Ribasim transfer before management-memory claims are admissible.
boundaries: Do not tune the DUMMY-20E2 frozen references to the no-exchange trajectory.
Do not qualify DUMMY-20F from this result.
Do not classify the groundwater-memory hypothesis itself as falsified.
downstream: DUMMY-20E3: use a separate active DRN cell hydraulically supported by a CHD source cell, preserving the frozen physical transfer schedule and management hypothesis.
